tools.name: Exam Oracle
tools.description: Predicts the questions your next test is most likely to ask.
tools.input_prompt: What topic or class is your next test on?

tools.name: Knowledge Gap Scanner
tools.description: Finds the topics you have not learned yet, before a test does.
tools.input_prompt: What are you studying right now?

tools.name: MV Study Planner
tools.description: Turns a test date into a day-by-day study plan.
tools.input_prompt: When is your test and what is it about?

tools.name: Smart Summarizer
tools.description: Cuts long notes or a chapter down to what matters.
tools.input_prompt: Paste your notes or chapter text here...

tools.name: Spaced Repetition Engine
tools.description: Brings each card back right before you would forget it.
tools.input_prompt: What do you need to memorize?

tools.name: Concept Storyteller
tools.description: Explains a hard idea as a story you will actually remember.
tools.input_prompt: What concept are you struggling to understand?

tools.name: Debate Mode
tools.description: Argues the other side so you learn to defend your answer.

tools.name: Curiosity Rabbit Hole
tools.description: Follow a question as far down as it goes.

tools.name: Study Streaks & XP
tools.description: Tracks your daily streak and XP so studying keeps its momentum.

tools.name: Personality-Matched Tutor
tools.description: A tutor that teaches in the style you learn from best.
tools.input_prompt: Describe your learning style and what you want to learn...

tools.name: Make It Click
tools.description: Re-explains the one thing you are stuck on until it lands.
tools.input_prompt: What exactly are you stuck on right now?

tools.name: Feynman Teacher Mode
tools.description: You teach the topic back, and it catches what you skipped.

tools.name: Deep Understanding
tools.description: Goes past the answer to why it is the answer.
tools.input_prompt: What answer do you want to understand deeply?

tools.name: Mental Model Builder
tools.description: Maps how the ideas in a subject connect to each other.
tools.input_prompt: What subject are you mapping out?

tools.name: Essay Brutalist
tools.description: Blunt, specific feedback on your writing. No flattery.

tools.name: Cross-Subject Finder
tools.description: Shows where what you are learning shows up in other subjects.

tools.name: Metacognition Coach
tools.description: Coaches how you study, not just what you study.
tools.input_prompt: How do you usually study for a test?

tools.name: Professor Mode
tools.description: University-level depth on a topic you already half know.
tools.input_prompt: What topic do you want to master at a university level?
